prompt:

PRIMARY ORIGINAL Image1 governs reply-connector curve geometry, stroke optical weight, proportions, alignment and fine spacing. Mock Image2 is secondary for exact Japanese localization and logical390x64px structure; do not inherit crude line corners or mint avatar fill. Image3 style only.

At left source-faithful neutral-slate elbow connector: vertical line rises from below, smoothly bends through a rounded upper-left corner, then extends right toward the small avatar. Logical connector20x30px, consistent slim stroke, no arrowhead or extra branch.
Next, small22px WHITE circular avatar with fine neutral outline and forest-green exact「佐」(intentional localized initial adaptation, not a portrait). Beside it, exact clickable name「佐藤さん」in MeiryoBold logical12px/16px tracking0,forestgreen#1F6444. Below name, exact excerpt「この資料を使ってみましょう」in MeiryoRegular12/16tracking0,supporting slate#526173, one line. Avatar initial MeiryoBold14/24tracking0. Color evidence: source cyan participant mention denotes a linked identity; adapt name to forestgreen. Connector/excerpt stay neutral, avatar white rather than mock mint. No decorative tint, no new action button/gradient. Source screenshot's unrelated floating down-scroll button overlaps outside reply context; do not include it or invent an arrow action.
Landscape3:1, ONE complete fragment uniformly enlarged at center with modest white margins. No extra mentions, counts, user portraits, quoted message card, heading, phone frame, video content, chat composer or labels. Full Japanese glyphs and clear restrained visual mapping from connector to named person/excerpt.
